sentences.text: 3. FIR in Crime No.372/2023 was registered by Raibag Police Station, Belagavi District for aforesaid offences against the petitioner and two others on the basis of the complaint dated 25.11.2023 lodged by Shobha Ramayya Pujeri, who is the mother of deceased-Jayashree.
In the complaint dated 25.11.2023, it is averred that the marriage of her second daughter-Jayashree with the petitioner was solemnized on 09.06.2023.
After the marriage, for a period of one month, the complainant's daughter-Jayashree was properly NC: 2024:KHC-D:937 looked after by the petitioner and his family members.
Thereafter, there was constant ill- treatment in her matrimonial house and accused were abusing the deceased-Jayashree on petty issues.
It is also averred in the complaint that accused were abusing deceased-Jayashree on the ground that she had suppressed about her earlier marriage and had cheated accused persons.
It is further alleged in the complaint that on 24.11.2023, complainant received information that her daughter-Jayashree had consumed poison and she was taken to the hospital.
Immediately, the complainant and her relatives rushed to the hospital and found that Jayashree had died in the hospital at about 2.30 p.m. on 24.11.2023.
The complaint was lodged on 25.11.2023 at about 13.30 hours.
4. During the course of investigation, the petitioner was arrested on 29.11.2023.

sentences.text: In the complaint it is also averred that accused were abusing the daughter of the complainant on the ground that she had suppressed her earlier marriage and had cheated accused and their family members.
Undisputedly the complainant's daughter had committed suicide on 24.11.2023 by consuming poison and she died in the hospital at about 2.30 p.m. on same day.
There is no mention in the complaint about any incident that had taken place on 24.11.2023, which could have instigated or abetted the deceased to commit suicide.
Therefore, the necessary ingredients for attracting the offence punishable under Section 306 of the IPC is prima facie not found in the complaint.
There is a delay of 23 hours in lodging the complaint.
The petitioner has no criminal antecedents and he is in custody from 29.11.2023 onwards.
Major portion of the investigation is completed.
Accused Nos.2 NC: 2024:KHC-D:937 and 3 have been granted bail by the Magistrate Court.
Under these circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner is required to be answered in the affirmative.

Accordingly the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.372/2023 registered by Raibag Police Station, Belagavi District for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 306 of the IPC, subject to the following conditions:
i.
The petitioner/accused No.1 shall execute personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties for the likesum, to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court.
ii. The petitioner/accused No.1 shall appear regularly on all the dates of hearing before the Trial Court unless the Trial NC: 2024:KHC-D:937 Court exempts his appearance for valid reasons.
iii. The petitioner/accused No.1 shall not directly or indirectly threaten or tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
iv. The petitioner/accused No.1 shall not involve in similar offences in future.
v. The petitioner/accused No.1 shall not leave the jurisdiction of the Trial Court without permission of the said Court until the case registered against him is disposed off.
